Units: m, cm, mm, rad, deg, s, ms and Hz convert; any other unit must match exactly. A row with requires_capability or absent_capability holds only where the surface declares (or its review presupposes) that capability, or does not. Statement surfaces are fnmatch patterns over the keys below; literal_index picks the n-th occurrence of the literal in its text. Phase 2 generates the successor sentences from these owners.
